name: Ollama
description: Lets Claude query and manage a local Ollama server — list models, inspect them, pull/delete, and run generate/chat completions.
long_description:
Designed for users who run local LLMs alongside Claude. Claude can enumerate your installed models, check what's currently loaded in VRAM, run one-shot generate or chat completions against any local model, and (optionally) pull or delete models.

Typical use: comparing Claude's output to a local model on the same prompt, running cheap bulk completions via a quantized model, or checking training-checkpoint models (e.g. custom Ollama imports from your own training runs) without opening a terminal.

**Requires** a running Ollama server (`ollama serve` or the Ollama app). Default endpoint is `http://localhost:11434`; override via the `ollama_url` user config if you run it on a different host/port. No npm dependencies — pure Node over the HTTP API.

ollama_url.title: Ollama server URL
ollama_url.description: Base URL of the Ollama HTTP API. Leave blank to use http://localhost:11434.

tools.name: ollama_status
tools.description: Health check: whether the Ollama server is reachable and its version. Useful as a precondition before other tools.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List locally-installed models (name, size, digest, modified timestamp, parameter size, quantization).

tools.name: list_running
tools.description: List models currently loaded into VRAM (name, size, expires_at). Empty list means Ollama is idle.

tools.name: show_model
tools.description: Show detailed info for one model: modelfile excerpt, parameters, template, capabilities, architecture, parameter count, quantization level.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Run a one-shot text completion against a local model (non-streaming). Returns the full response plus evaluation timings.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Run a chat completion against a local model with message history (non-streaming). Returns the assistant's reply plus timings.

tools.name: pull_model
tools.description: Download a model from the Ollama registry. Blocks until the pull completes — can take a while for large models.

tools.name: delete_model
tools.description: Delete a locally-installed model. Does not affect remote-registry copies.
